publishedRules: A setup candle has low above its own SMA18.
Two consecutive completed setup candles are required.
Inside bars are rejected and break the consecutive count.
Entry activates only after the second qualifying candle closes.
Entry is a subsequent breakout above the qualifying highs.
Exit is the corresponding opposite qualified signal.
Long or flat. No leverage. No pyramiding.
apexAssumptions: Qualifying high is the max high of the two setup candles.
If the next open gaps through that high, fill at the open. Otherwise fill at the high.
Exit fill uses the same conservative rule on the opposite setup.
Cost is 6 bps per side at baseline, 12 bps at 2x, 30 bps severe.
